notes: Complete individual Broom Bridge exterior: separate open canal/towpath and railway skew masonry arches, curved broad granite spandrels, pale radial arch stones and dark barrel joints, full narrow humped roadway/eastern sidewalk, continuous stone parapets with dark coping, small battered pier faces and plain canal-side commemoration panels. Fixed35m standard model datum. Approximate gently humped road rises from39.6..40.0m at its ends to41.55m near the middle. Short end shoulders flatten to meet the mapped road and sidewalk. Standard review water samples 35.390m. The coarse ground field is below the bridge bank road, so the native renderer supplies graded approaches. Vault rise, masonry thickness and foundation levels are ordinary-photo exterior proportions; these elevations fit the standard viewer and are not a survey.
